notes: Good n=53, 55, and 61 and G-matrices at n=49 and 59 have no published existence source here: their existence on the board comes from imported, exactly verified vxvware/saw-best-matrix rows. G-matrices at 51, 55, and 63 exist by Spence's infinite family; the imported censuses add the class counts.
A contradicted record is a published nonexistence claim that exactly verified rows on this board refute. It is neither an existence nor an emptiness source.
Missing records mean unresolved within this sourced baseline, not a claim of exhaustive literature review.

A Williamson record at even n up to 70 carries published_classes: the class count of the cited enumeration and the equivalence it was counted under, which is coarser than equiv-v1. No good, best or G-matrix record exists at even n, because a skew circulant block needs odd n.
